execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."address" (
  "addressLine1" text NOT NULL,
  "addressLine2" text,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isDefault" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "label" text,
  "latitude" float8,
  "longitude" float8,
  "postalCode" text,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'HOME' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "address_type_check_1d56252c" CHECK ("type" IN ('HOME', 'WORK', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cart" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cartItem" (
  "cartId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "menuItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" float8 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."delivery" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveredTime" timestamptz,
  "estimatedTime" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "pickedUpTime" timestamptz,
  "pickupTime" timestamptz,
  "riderId" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'UNASSIGNED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "delivery_status_check_ac39afbe" CHECK ("status" IN ('UNASSIGNED', 'ASSIGNED', 'ACCEPTED', 'PICKED_UP', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'DELIVERED', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."menuCategory" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "shopId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."menuItem" (
  "categoryId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "isAvailable" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isFeatured" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" float8 NOT NULL,
  "shopId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."menuItemOption" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isAvailable" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "menuItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order" (
  "addressId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "deliveryFee" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "discount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "orderNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "serviceFee" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "shopId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" float8 NOT NULL,
  "total" float8 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "order_status_check_2f522ee9" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'PREPARING', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'PICKED_UP', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orderItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "menuItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "options" text,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "totalPrice" float8 NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payment" (
  "amount" float8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'USD' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "provider" text,
  "providerPaymentId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payment_method_check_b883bcec" CHECK ("method" IN ('CARD', 'CASH', 'ONLINE')),
  CONSTRAINT "payment_status_check_cc2a0cd7" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."review" (
  "comment" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "shopId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rider" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currentLatitude" float8,
  "currentLongitude" float8,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isAvailable" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "vehicleNumber" text,
  "vehicleType" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."shop" (
  "address" text,
  "city" text,
  "coverImageUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveryFee" float8,
  "description" text,
  "email" text,
  "estimatedMinutes" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8,
  "logoUrl" text,
  "longitude" float8,
  "minimumOrder" float8,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "sellerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "shop_status_check_474c699a" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'CLOSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscription" (
  "autoRenew" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nextDelivery" timestamptz,
  "planId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "subscription_status_check_c866169c" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscriptionPlan" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "mealsPerPeriod" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" float8 NOT NULL,
  "shopId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "subscriptionPlan_type_check_b7b8ccce" CHECK ("type" IN ('DAILY', 'WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "avatarUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_role_check_69c181bf" CHECK ("role" IN ('CUSTOMER', 'SELLER', 'RIDER', 'ADMIN'))
)
